card.text: Sun-like star about 215 parsecs away that hosts the hot giant WASP-39 b.

introduction.text: WASP-39 is a Sun-like star about 215 parsecs away, 0.94 times the Sun’s radius. Its giant planet WASP-39 b circles it every four days.
